blake2b_transcript.absorb: common_point: 0x01 || x || y (affine, canonical LE); common_scalar: 0x02 || repr; write_* absorbs as common_* and appends the compressed point or repr to the stream
blake2b_transcript.absorbed: byte length of absorbed_hex consumed when the challenge was squeezed
blake2b_transcript.squeeze: absorb 0x00, finalize a copy of the state, challenge = from_uniform_bytes(64 bytes); the state continues

confidential_v3_poseidon.construction: identical to kagemusha_v1_poseidon (the length word is F::from_u128(len)); production uses Fp only, Fq is pinned by the existing tests
confidential_v3_poseidon.empty_subtree_roots: roots[0] = hash(cfleaf03, [0]); roots[i + 1] = hash(cfnode03, [roots[i], roots[i]]) up to depth 16
confidential_v3_poseidon.note_commitment: hash(cfnote03, [amount as F::from_u128, rho scalar, owner tag, asset tag]); the 12th vector is note-shaped
confidential_v3_poseidon.production_anchors: hash(cfownr03, [3, 5]), hash(cfnote03, [3, 5, 8, 13]) and hash(cfnet_03, [3]) on Fp and Fq, pinned by secure_confidential_poseidon_kats_pin_both_pasta_fields_and_domains in crates/iroha_core_zk/src/confidential_v2_tests.rs and checked against this reproduction by confidential_reproduction_matches_iroha_core_zk_kats

iroha_core_zk_kagemusha.source: pinned here, never regenerated: recorded from crates/iroha_core_zk/src/prover_golden_tests.rs at oracle_baseline.repository_head
iroha_core_zk_kagemusha.transcript: KAGEMUSHA PoseidonTranscript<C, NativeLoader, _, 3, 2, 8, 57>; recovery seed [7; 32]; folded generator appended

vendored_halo2_axiom.transcript: Blake2bWrite<_, C, Challenge255<C>>; prover RNG ChaCha20Rng::from_seed([seed; 32])

kagemusha_v1_poseidon.construction: snark_verifier Poseidon<F, F, 3, 2>::from_spec(NativeLoader, OptimizedPoseidonSpec<F, 3, 2>::new::<8, 57, 0>()); clear; update([F::from(domain), F::from(len), inputs..]); squeeze
kagemusha_v1_poseidon.domain: the 8 ASCII bytes read as a little-endian u64 (u64::from_le_bytes(*b"kgmnode1"))
kagemusha_v1_poseidon.empty_replay_root: r = hash(kgmemp_1, []); 256 times r = hash(kgmnode1, [r, r])
kagemusha_v1_poseidon.production_anchors: the vendored sponge (construction below) is anchored by the confidential_v3_poseidon production anchors; iroha_pasta::poseidon::hash_with_domain (iroha_plonk_oracle tests/pasta_parity, with the empty replay root), the iroha_plonk_gadgets sponge chip and iroha_kagemusha_proof (tests/digest_parity.rs in each) assert every vector
kagemusha_v1_poseidon.reproduces: the KAGEMUSHA domain hash hash::<F>(domain, inputs) on the vendored sponge; natively iroha_pasta::poseidon::hash_with_domain::<F>(domain, inputs)

params_ipa.layout: u32_le(k) || g[0..2^k] || g_lagrange[0..2^k] || w || u, points compressed (32 B)
params_ipa.section_digests: g_sha256 covers the g section, g_lagrange_sha256 the g_lagrange section

poseidon_transcript.absorb: common_point: [fe_to_fe(x), fe_to_fe(y)] in the scalar field; common_scalar: the scalar; write_* absorbs as common_* and appends the compressed point or repr to the stream
poseidon_transcript.absorbed: number of absorbed elements consumed when the challenge was squeezed
poseidon_transcript.squeeze: snark-verifier Poseidon sponge over the buffered elements (initial capacity 2^64, pad 1 then 0s, an extra permutation when the buffer length is a multiple of the rate); challenge = state[1]
poseidon_transcript.users: iroha_plonk TranscriptV1::KagemushaPoseidonRp57 in oracle mode (spec section 6.2): width 3, rate 2, 8 full and 57 partial rounds, MDS 0
